subject: Re: Kickoff: sentence-level LMs for storyline coherence
body:
Status + a risk on the transfer.

Reproduction: done on schedule. Downloaded checkpoints reproduce the paper's Table 1/2 accuracy numbers on ROC Stories, and our retrained model from the released mean-BERT embedding dataset lands within 0.4 points.

Drafting corpus: Gustavo's Beam job finished - 1.1M sentences embedded. First fine-tunes show the coherence signal transfers, but weaker: next-sentence ranking accuracy drops from 72% (ROC) to 61% on held-out drafts. Root cause looks structural - ROC Stories are five tight sentences; real drafts have digressions that aren't incoherence.

The risk: if we score raw next-sentence plausibility, the service will flag every intentional digression. Mitigation in test: score at the paragraph level and flag only sustained drops across 3+ sentences. Early precision on Wanjiru's labeled set improved from 0.44 to 0.71 with that windowing.

Demo still on for mid-May.

Halima
